projects.name: Establish and improve surveillance, early warning, preparedness and response systems to climatic shocks to reduce risks and vulnerability at household and community level
projects.description: Coordinated actions to establish and strengthen surveillance, early warning, preparedness, and response systems for climatic shocks at national, sub-national, and community levels. Planned interventions will focus on scaling up climate-related early warning information systems through enhanced digital platforms, e-extension, and climate advisory services, supported by regular updating of risk maps and the generation of key analytical products (IPC, CFSAM, FSNMS, and Food Balance Sheets) to inform anticipatory action. Institutional and community capacities for disaster risk management will be strengthened through targeted EWEA and preparedness training, including engagement of youth and local actors, alongside improvements in community-level data and knowledge systems and the promotion of nature-based solutions to reduce flood and drought risks. Gender-responsive approaches, including tailored early warning information for women, will be integrated to ensure inclusive risk reduction and reduced vulnerability at household and community levels.
projects.outcome: Output 2.6 Relevant MDAs, LGAs and communities are better equipped to establish and maintain inclusive, gender-responsive, early warning systems and disaster preparedness, response and recovery mechanisms

projects.description: In line with security sector reform, South Sudan National Police Service envisions to reform its policing service for a community-oriented policing service. Assumptions
	Peace agreement (R-ARCSS) holds and all stakeholders at regional, national, state and local level remain committed or can be persuaded to commit to the full range of peacebuilding interventions envisaged, including those national actors who are not currently signatories.
